wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim tree branches that hang over or touch the house and any outbuildings.
• Thin trees in the cluster closest to the structure to create open space between individual trees.
• Remove shrubs and other plants growing directly against the exterior walls of the house.
• Cut tall grass in the area surrounding the structure down to a short, mowed height.
• Clear woody debris, including fallen branches, dead wood, and brush piles, from around the structure and outbuildings.
• Separate shrubs from nearby trees so fire cannot move directly from low plants up into the tree canopy.
• Mow or cut the grass cover across the open terrain between the structure and surrounding vegetation.
• Remove ground vegetation growing up against the foundation, fence lines, and any attached structures.
• Keep the single access route clear of overhanging branches and encroaching vegetation along both sides.
• Cut back mixed vegetation along the driveway edges so emergency vehicles can pass through without obstruction.
• Thin scattered trees near the structure so there is open ground visible between each tree trunk.
• Remove dead material from within shrub groupings near the house and outbuildings.
• Keep the area under trees near the structure free of fallen leaves, needles, and small branches.
